blocks.text: Organizing your browser for deep work

SEO work involves juggling dozens of tabs. You have the client dashboard, the Google Search Console property, a keyword research tool, and your project management board. To keep your head clear, use Chrome profiles. Go to your profile icon in the top right, select Add, and create a unique space for every client. This keeps your cookies and extensions isolated. You can even assign different colors to each profile window to see which client you are working on at a glance.
Essential keyboard shortcuts for SEO speed

items: ⌘ + T: Open a new tab instantly.
⌘ + L: Jump to the address bar to type a new URL or search query.
⌘ + Option + Right Arrow: Switch to the next tab in your sequence.
⌘ + Shift + T: Reopen the last tab you accidentally closed.

blocks.text: If you find yourself opening the same five tools every morning, set them as your startup pages. Go to Chrome > Settings > On startup and choose Open a specific page or set of pages. Add your rank tracker, your analytics suite, and your favorite SEO news site. They will be waiting for you the moment you launch the app.

When a page looks wrong, it is often a cache issue. Instead of clearing everything, learn to clear data for just one site. Open the site, click the lock icon in the address bar, and select Site settings. From there, you can clear data for that specific domain. This is safer than wiping your entire browser history.

If you are stuck on a complex audit tool, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask Lazur where a specific setting is located. Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item so you can find it without searching through nested submenus.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Chrome for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points, explains, and guides you, but it does not click buttons or operate the browser for you.

faq.question: How do I speed up Chrome on my Mac?
faq.answer: Remove unused extensions, clear your cache regularly, and ensure you are running the latest version of Chrome for your macOS version.
